response.justification: The candidate significantly exceeds the technical requirements — nearly two decades of fullstack experience with strong TypeScript/Node.js, React exposure, Kubernetes, AWS, and recent LLM/MCP work covering most nice-to-haves. However, this is an entry-level role, and a Staff/Senior engineer with ~18 years of experience is heavily overqualified, raising serious questions about salary fit, motivation, and retention. Worth a conversation only if compensation expectations and the reason for seeking a junior IC role can be clarified upfront.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js and fullstack experience across many production systems
Covers most nice-to-haves: LLM/AI-agent tooling, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker
Berlin-based, compatible with high on-site presence requirement
concerns: Strongly overqualified for an entry-level position; likely salary and retention mismatch
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (mainly MongoDB/MySQL, Ember.js)
Only basic German, which may matter for a German energy-consulting domain platform
